tools.description: A lightweight CNN+GRU model for monophonic/polyphonic note transcription. Emits note events and pitch contours. The reference for fast, browser-friendly audio-to-MIDI.
tools.notes: Included in the official Spotify/basic-pitch repo. Works on CPU.

tools.description: Hybrid Transformer/DenseNet for music source separation (vocals, drums, bass, other). State-of-the-art on MUSDB18. Hybrid Spectrogram + Waveform.
tools.notes: GPU recommended for full tracks; CPU works on 30s clips.

tools.description: Robust speech recognition via large-scale weak supervision. Multilingual, 99 languages, with translation to English. The de-facto ASR baseline.
tools.notes: Use whisper-large-v3 on GPU; tiny/base run on CPU.

tools.description: Simple and controllable music generation by Meta. Text or melody-conditioned. Includes MusicGen, AudioGen, and EnCodec. ~3.3B params.
tools.notes: GPU required (16GB+ VRAM for the large model).

tools.description: Retrieval-based voice conversion with a Gradio WebUI. Train on 10 minutes of clean audio, run real-time inference on CPU. Hugely popular in the open-source music community.
tools.notes: CPU runs inference; training is faster on GPU.

tools.description: Transformer-based text-to-audio model. Generates highly realistic multilingual speech, music, sound effects, and non-verbal communication (laughter, sighs).
tools.notes: GPU strongly recommended. ~5s to generate 10s of audio on A10G.

tools.description: Neural building blocks for speaker diarization: voice activity detection, speaker change detection, overlapped speech detection, and embedding.
tools.notes: Needs a Hugging Face token to download the gated models.

tools.description: Stability AI's image-to-video diffusion model. 14 frames at 3-30 fps from a single starting image. The reference I2V baseline.
tools.notes: Requires 16GB+ VRAM GPU.

tools.description: Text-to-video and image-to-video generation from Tsinghua. Open-source, Apache 2.0 license, 5B parameters. Generates 6s at 30 fps.
tools.notes: Multi-GPU recommended for full resolution.

tools.description: A plug-in motion module for Stable Diffusion that turns any SD checkpoint into an image-to-video generator. Lightweight and composable.
tools.notes: GPU required, but lighter than SVD.

tools.description: Stability AI's open audio generation model. 1.1B parameter latent diffusion for sound design, music, and SFX. Text-conditioned.
tools.notes: GPU recommended (A10G+).

tools.description: Compact (82M) high-quality multilingual TTS. Apache 2.0, fast on CPU, near-SOTA quality for its size. American/British English, plus French/Italian/Spanish/Portuguese/Hi/ja/zh.
tools.notes: CPU-friendly, 2GB RAM.

tools.description: Grounding DINO + Segment Anything. Detect and segment anything in an image from a text prompt. The workhorse for open-vocabulary vision pipelines.
tools.notes: GPU required, ~6GB VRAM for the base models.

tools.description: Fast 3D object reconstruction from a single image. Transformer-based, runs in seconds on a GPU. Apache 2.0, commercial-friendly.
tools.notes: GPU recommended; CPU is ~1 min/inference.

tools.description: IBM's document parsing library. Reads PDFs, DOCX, PPTX, images → structured JSON/Markdown. Handles tables, formulas, and reading order.
tools.notes: CPU-friendly for most documents.

tools.description: Versatile voice-cloning TTS with tone-color control, accent, emotion, rhythm, intonation. Cross-lingual. Apache 2.0 (with commercial restrictions).
tools.notes: GPU recommended for inference; CPU possible for short clips.

tools.description: OCR in 90+ languages, plus layout analysis, table recognition, and reading order. State-of-the-art on benchmarks, MIT-licensed.
tools.notes: GPU recommended; CPU works on page-by-page.

tools.description: Multilingual voice cloning TTS from a 6s reference clip. 17 languages, speaker-conditioning via cross-attention. CPML license.
tools.notes: GPU recommended.

tools.description: No Language Left Behind: 200-language translation, dense and distilled variants. The open-source multilingual baseline.
tools.notes: Distilled 600M runs on CPU; 3.3B/54B on GPU.

tools.description: Multimodal multitask translation: speech-to-speech, speech-to-text, text-to-speech, text-to-text. 100+ languages.
tools.notes: GPU required for the large variant.

tools.description: Neural network structure to control Stable Diffusion with spatial conditioning (canny, depth, pose, etc.). The reference for guided image generation.
tools.notes: GPU recommended (8GB+ VRAM).

tools.description: Diffusion-based monocular depth estimation. State-of-the-art on multiple benchmarks, Apache 2.0, single-image depth in seconds.
tools.notes: GPU recommended; CPU works on small images.
